name: Synchronous-speed device
summary: Recognises a speed condition associated with synchronism during a machine sequence.
description: Recognises a speed condition associated with synchronism during a machine sequence.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the speed reference and synchronous-speed criterion. The associated drawing should trace the next-step permission in the start sequence; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the speed reference and synchronous-speed criterion.
Trace the next-step permission in the start sequence.
drawingChecklist: Label the speed reference and synchronous-speed criterion.
Cross-reference the next-step permission in the start sequence.
Identify the device tag, manual revision and logic drawing that define this implementation.
distinction: Recognising synchronous speed does not demonstrate the voltage and phase conditions checked by device 25.
